spec.description: Frontend monitoring dashboard using metrics collected with Grafana Faro SDK.

spec.title: Largest Contentful Paint (LCP)
spec.description:
Largest Contentful Paint (LCP): measures loading performance. To provide a good user experience, LCP should occur within 2.5 seconds of when the page first starts loading.
https://web.dev/lcp/

spec.expr: deployment.environment.name:"$env" AND service.name:"$app" AND measurement.name:"lcp" | stats avg(measurement.value)

spec.title: Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS)
spec.description:
Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS): measures visual stability. To provide a good user experience, pages should maintain a CLS of 0.1. or less.
https://web.dev/cls/

spec.expr: deployment.environment.name:"$env" AND service.name:"$app" AND measurement.name:"cls" | stats avg(measurement.value)

spec.title: Interaction to Next Paint (INP)
spec.description:
First Input Delay (FID): measures interactivity. To provide a good user experience, pages should have a FID of 100 milliseconds or less.
https://web.dev/fid/

spec.expr: deployment.environment.name:"$env" AND service.name:"$app" AND measurement.name:"inp" | stats avg(measurement.value)
deployment.environment.name:"$env" AND service.name:"$app" AND exception.type:* | stats count()

spec.title: Page Load, p75
spec.description:
TTFB is a metric that measures the time between the request for a resource and when the first byte of a response begins to arrive.
https://web.dev/ttfb/

spec.expr: deployment.environment.name:"$env" AND service.name:"$app" AND measurement.name:"ttfb" | stats quantile(0.75, measurement.value)
deployment.environment.name:"$env" AND service.name:"$app" AND measurement.name:"fcp" | stats quantile(0.75, measurement.value)
deployment.environment.name:"$env" AND service.name:"$app" AND measurement.name:"lcp" | stats quantile(0.75, measurement.value)
deployment.environment.name:"$env" AND service.name:"$app" AND exception.type:* | stats by (exception.message, exception.type) count() as logs | sort by (logs desc) | limit 10
deployment.environment.name:"$env" AND service.name:"$app" AND exception.type:* | stats by (url.full) count() as logs | sort by (logs desc) | limit 10
deployment.environment.name:"$env" AND service.name:"$app" AND exception.type:* | stats by (browser.name, browser.version) count() as logs | sort by (logs desc) | limit 10
deployment.environment.name:"$env" AND service.name:"$app" AND exception.type:* | stats count()
deployment.environment.name:"$env" AND service.name:"$app" AND measurement.name:"ttfb" | stats by (browser.name, browser.version) count() as logs | sort by (logs desc) | limit 10
deployment.environment.name:"$env" AND service.name:"$app" AND measurement.name:"ttfb" | stats by (_stream) count() as logs
deployment.environment.name:"$env" AND service.name:"$app" AND event.name:* | stats by (event.name) count() as logs | sort by (logs desc) | limit 10

options.content:
# Web Vitals

spec.expr: deployment.environment.name:"$env" AND service.name:"$app" AND event.name:* | stats by (event.attributes.session.id) count() as logs | sort by (logs desc) | limit 50

spec.title: First Contentful Paint (FCP)
spec.description:
The First Contentful Paint (FCP) metric measures the time from when the page starts loading to when any part of the page's content is rendered on the screen. For this metric, "content" refers to text, images (including background images), <svg> elements, or non-white <canvas> elements.
https://web.dev/fcp/

spec.expr: deployment.environment.name:"$env" AND service.name:"$app" AND measurement.name:"fcp" | stats avg(measurement.value)
